Excel is input only.","CP-OS":"Orchestrates selected analysis, current handoffs, bounded retries/cost, resume and verified delivery.","CP-2D":"Builds the near-term liquidity bridge and cash runway.","CP-3D":"Assesses market-implied credit risk and trading technicals.","CP-3C":"Assesses refinancing and liability-management risk before or during distress."},"sources":{"annual-selected":"ec0dbd96488e2f6977a42bfc17085b6dd8410a9b39db7e7a0a3670c2d701f58b","base-indenture":"ef8ad4d8a3d5902746726697b6f6fa53058d7445b59d99157cbea6258bf2d459","supplement":"bf82a65cae422d4814fa292ab3b9e5e5324f74d09643d6367ad6110055e6390c","selected-method":"8a3b12f3f37359463434177759febac1ffcf0f8c484aa0508eb7119f7b6548b2","method-runbook":"1ca9d2d86d40772d6c4a1df3052af174ab10ee80a27460dfcee0de93a227e5bc","method-steps":"30cf03f343a9153aa85d6492e6bad519ab5d639395dae2b686de4b8276764e98","checked-controls":"5d03be730a3b856f071ae09c13a7771a41804bb5173d82cd4736b25f20fb9bbd"},"handoffs":{"CP-0":{"sha256":"8347534cab302ae92b4e097f7a7d08a0ea69945337a0cadaf575526578ea83e5","markdown":"# CP-0 — ARCC historical source admission

## Request

Admit the selected Ares Capital Corporation FY2024 financial and July 2029
note sources under `instructions.md`. Ready with limitations for this case.
Actual current host-model work on 2026-11-04, with session context; no provider
run or native source-pack qualification. Historical balances are 2024-12-31.

## Sources

- `sources/ARCC-FY2024-10K.pdf`: original issuer-hosted 320-page PDF,
  SHA-256 `4483569e723b1a0c479d1ce45bcf64e11f6c82c98754bce1aa317641eb81e170`.
  `annual-pages.txt` is a pypdf derivative, with 1-based PDF page markers.
- `sources/base-lines.txt`: full indexed SEC Exhibit 4.1, May 13, 2024 base
  indenture, 1,706 indexed lines; `sources/supplement-lines.txt`: full indexed
  SEC Exhibit 4.2, same-date first supplement, 525 lines. Exact tool captures
  remain in `legal-web-captures.json`; original legal HTML byte requests were
  refused with HTTP403. No access bypass was attempted.

## Findings

| Check | Source / admission result |
|---|---|
| Issuer identity | Annual cover names Ares Capital Corporation, not Ares Management or an unrelated REIT; the base L6 and supplement L16 name that same issuer. |
| Selected contract identity | Annual PDF p104, Exhibits 4.22–24, identifies the base, first supplement and 5.950% July 2029 note form; the actual source filenames/accessions were resolved from those references. |
| Executed state | Base L4 marks execution version; L1686–1705 and supplement L324–339 contain execution statements and named `/s/` blocks for Company and Trustee. No cryptographic or enforceability opinion. |
| Series and priority | Supplement 1.01(a) / L73 designates these notes Senior Securities; other series and subsidiary obligations have distinct terms. |
| Period and publication | 2024-12-31 financial snapshot, annual audit report dated February 5, 2025 (PDF p112). Retrieval/execution in November 2026 is not a 2024 point-in-time access backtest. |
| Visual/source agreement | Retained PDF p65 visually confirms July 2029 principal 850 and coverage per unit 1,962 plus its definition; p274 visually confirms principal versus carrying columns, coverage 196% and minimum 150%. These two page images were viewed, not all 320. |
| Legal text integrity | Every index retained, 744 matching base overlaps, 359 matching supplement overlaps. A shorter boundary truncation at base L815 is preserved in raw captures; the complete matching-prefix line is used in reconstruction. No unresolved differing source line. |
| Authority and scope | The two executed agreements and annual report support the selected coverage review. Other facility instruments, subsequent amendments, certificates and actual borrowing requests are not admitted as complete. |

## Calculations

No capacity calculation. File hashes, index coverage and matching-prefix
truncation checks are source-admission checks only.

## Gaps

Original legal HTML bytes/visual assurance; full agreement/amendment and
compliance-certificate set; present-day source update. A restricted historical
source pack cannot establish all-contract or current compliance.

## Next module

CP-1 must extract the actual published coverage presentation and its definition,
principal versus carrying amounts and dated subsequent events. CP-4 then reads
base plus supplement for the selected series; neither may assume EBITDA is this
test's numerator or the 850 note amount is the group's entire denominator.
"},"CP-1":{"sha256":"ed934cea757dec38962ec99f87e86725e4d10e08a2b4865e0bee1ebd3ab4b240","markdown":"# CP-1 — ARCC focused FY2024 coverage inputs

## Request

Actual focused extraction for CP-4/CP-4A, consuming CP-0
`8347534cab302ae92b4e097f7a7d08a0ea69945337a0cadaf575526578ea83e5`.
Issuer: Ares Capital Corporation and consolidated subsidiaries; FY2024 and
2024-12-31 closing balances. Analysis 2026-11-04, historical/outdated evidence.
Current host model with context; no complete CP-1 foundation/native pass claim.

## Sources

Original issuer-hosted FY2024 PDF and its pinned pypdf page text admitted by
CP-0. All page numbers below are **1-based PDF pages**. Financial-note amounts
are USD millions, except percentages/per-unit data. The named notes refer to
July 15, 2029 maturity, distinct from March 2029 notes.

## Findings

| ID | Published input | Amount / unit | Period / quantity role / locator |
|---|---|---:|---|
| F01 | Asset coverage | 196% | 2024-12-31; rounded whole-percent presentation; Note 5, PDF p274 / F-164. |
| F02 | Asset coverage per unit for July 2029 Notes | USD 1,962 per USD 1,000 | FY2024 closing; senior-securities table, PDF p65; not the note's market price, asset value per share or coupon. Same group coverage presentation recurs by class; do not sum it. |
| F03 | Coverage denominator/formula definition | See definition below | PDF p65 footnote 2. |
| F04 | Applicable reported borrowing coverage minimum | 150% | Note 5 p274, effective June 21, 2019, measured after borrowing; contractual incorporation remains CP-4's work. |
| F05 | Aggregate senior securities principal outstanding | 13,789 USDm | 2024-12-31, Note 5 p274. |
| F06 | Aggregate carrying debt | 13,727 USDm | Same date/Note 5 p274; not interchangeable with F05. |
| F07 | July 2029 note principal | 850 USDm | Same date/Note 5 p274, reconciles principal amount in senior-securities table p65. |
| F08 | July 2029 note carrying value | 835 USDm | Same date/p274; footnotes p275 include issue costs/discount-premium and hedge-accounting effects; not a principal reduction. |
| F09 | July 2029 contractual fixed coupon received under associated swap | 5.950% | Note 5 p282 / F-172 swap row; contract still to be checked by CP-4. |
| F10 | July 2029 effective stated interest rate including swap | 6.040% | Same page, debt table with footnote 1; different economic basis from contractual coupon. |
| F11 | Cash and cash equivalents | 635 USDm | 2024-12-31, MD&A PDF p88; not automatically nettable against covenant senior securities. |
| F12 | Reported additional facility availability | Approximately 5.1 USDbn | Same date, MD&A p88; expressly subject to borrowing-base and other restrictions. Not unconditional liquidity, legal basket capacity or extra coverage headroom. |
| E01 | New March 2032 notes issued | 1,000 USDm | January 2025 subsequent event, Note 16 p300; not December principal. 5.800% fixed coupon; forward-starting swap effective Jan 8, 2026, not an already active 2024 swap. |
| E02 | Share repurchase authorization extension | Up to 1,000 USDm aggregate authorization | February 2025, Note 16 pp300–301: expiry extended Feb 15, 2025 to Feb 15, 2026. This is authority, not evidence of an executed 1,000 repurchase or known unused authority. |

F03: coverage for senior debt is consolidated total assets less liabilities and
indebtedness not represented by senior securities, divided by total senior
securities representing indebtedness. The published per-unit figure is that
ratio multiplied by USD 1,000. The source describes exemptive relief for specified
SBA debentures and historical accounting reclassifications; do not infer new
exclusions or reclassify all liabilities as debt. EBITDA is not this numerator.

## Calculations

No headroom calculation here. F02 supplies finer **published** coverage precision
than F01; it is not an unrounded raw ratio. Principal and carrying value remain
separate source facts. F05 minus F06 is not available cash or incremental debt
capacity. No forecast or pro-forma post-period coverage is created.

## Gaps

Unrounded covenant numerator/denominator bridge, actual transaction-date
certificate, full facility/series covenant set, realized subsequent repurchases,
net new-debt uses and complete contemporaneous changes. This focused extraction
does not recalculate all financial statements, every facility or subsequent ratio.

## Next module

CP-4 should use F04 with the selected executed documents, retain exemptions and
series-specific changes, and classify the test trigger. CP-4A may then use F02
and F03 for a published-precision coverage cushion, without substituting F06,
F08, F11 or F12 for the contractual denominator or dollar borrowing capacity.
"},"CP-4":{"sha256":"ff4a8bb2eef5f1a735628a5d1e99f1662eb8078858d0be80a9c199f4307569c9","markdown":"# CP-4 — ARCC selected asset-coverage covenant

## Request

Interpret the 5.950% Notes due July 15, 2029 coverage provision for the historical
2024-12-31 CP-4A case. Actually consumed CP-0 and focused CP-1
`ed934cea757dec38962ec99f87e86725e4d10e08a2b4865e0bee1ebd3ab4b240`.
Current host model with context, 2026-11-04; this focused interpretation does not
replace full CP-4 duties or certify current/all-contract compliance.

## Sources

Admitted base indenture and first supplement, both May 13, 2024, complete
retained indexed text; annual PDF pp65,104,274–275,282. Source aliases B=base,
S=first supplement; L numbers are retained web indexes, not PDF line numbers.
The published annual report states the issuer's applicable 150% Act basis.
This is historical document interpretation, not independent legal advice.

## Findings

| ID | Clause / fact | Interpretation, risk mechanic and creditor implication |
|---|---|---|
| P01 | B 10.07 / L1384–1385 | While securities are outstanding, Company undertakes not to violate Act 18(a)(1)(A), modified by 61(a), amended/successor provisions and applicable Commission exemptive relief, whether or not otherwise subject to it. The covenant incorporates the statutory test; it is not a hard-coded standalone EBITDA ratio. |
| P02 | CP-1 F04 / annual p274, also p7 and p88 | Issuer reports its applicable minimum reduced to 150% effective June 21, 2019, measured after borrowing. Its published coverage is explicitly calculated on that Act basis. This supports the selected historical ratio comparison; it does not independently verify the exemption/approval record or a particular borrowing certificate. |
| P03 | S 1.01(a) / L73; 7.04 / L302 | Selected 5.950% 2029 notes are Senior Securities; base and supplement are read together, supplement prevails on conflicts for these notes. Other series cannot silently inherit all supplemental protections. The first supplement does not replace 10.07's formula. |
| P04 | S 1.01(g) / L96 | Covenant defeasance applies to 10.07 and 10.08 under base 14.03 and its conditions. No evidence of actual defeasance admitted; no assumption of perpetual non-defeasable control. |
| P05 | Annual p65 footnote 2, CP-1 F02/F03 | Published coverage per unit is the statutory senior-debt ratio times USD1,000, with specified SBA relief. Total senior securities and non-senior liabilities have distinct roles. Neither 835 carrying value of this note nor total carrying debt is automatically the contractual denominator. No EBITDA/add-back substitution. |
| P06 | S 1.01(b) / L74–76; B 3.01 | Initial note amount 850 USDm; additional same-series notes permitted subject to specified identical terms/tax conditions. No independent fixed incremental basket amount or presently usable debt authorization is established by an unlimited issuance framework. New borrowing must still satisfy applicable tests/other agreements. |
| P07 | B 5.01(vii) / L917 | Separate default limb uses asset coverage below 100% on the last business day of each of 24 consecutive calendar months. It is not the 150% transaction test, not a 24-month general grace period for all covenant breaches, and not a present default conclusion from one balance date. |
| P08 | S 4.03 / L216–217 | Other-agreement breach limb has 60 consecutive calendar days after specified written notice from Trustee or holders of at least 25% principal. Actual breach/notice/time series are not supplied. A snapshot crossing 150% cannot alone certify acceleration or this limb. |
| P09 | B 9.02 / L1311–1314 | General majority amendment power has affected-holder exceptions, expressly including modification of specified 10.07 protection subject to its wording. No assumption that any majority can simply erase it. |
| P10 | S Article Six / L257–282, especially L262 | Selected change-of-control repurchase event combines control and defined below-investment-grade rating event, subject to exceptions and lawful/procedural conditions. Its price is **100%**, plus accrued unpaid interest. TDG's separate 101% term must not migrate into this case. |

The selected asset-coverage comparison is **an incurrence/issuance restriction**
under the incorporated provisions, not proof of an independently continuously
tested 150% maintenance covenant in every facility. Market-value deterioration
can reduce the cushion and limit future financing; actual covenant/default
consequences require the relevant triggers, definitions, time history and notices.
The separate 100% duration limb and other-agreement breach limb remain distinct.

## Calculations

None owned here. Pass F02/F03/F04 to CP-4A for a published-precision cushion.
No remaining basket, cash borrowing amount, PD, LGD or recovery is calculated.

## Gaps

Underlying Act approval/exemption record, complete series/facility amendment
chain, unrounded ratio/certificate, borrowing-base and other financial tests,
actual defeasance/amendment/usage/notice history. Financial-investment value
declines matter on an asset-value basis; no industrial EBITDA bridge applies to
this selected test. Other agreements may contain additional baskets/constraints.

## Next module

CP-4A should quantify only the supported historical ratio cushion; carry P04,
P07–P09 control limitations and the unknown dollar borrowing/leakage capacity.
It must not add independent routes or call the group unrestricted merely because
this selected covenant's headroom is positive. CP-6 then challenges that claim.
"}}}

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List pinned issuer sources, hashes and page counts.

tools.name: read_pages
tools.description: Read up to eight pages, numbered from one. Cite the source and page.

tools.name: search_source
tools.description: Find up to twenty matching source excerpts with page locators.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Use the existing Decimal-38 kernel. Sum signed operands, or divide two operands. Values are decimal strings or null for missing; ratios are fractions, not percentages. A ratio requires a strictly positive denominator; otherwise it returns null with a reason. Keep period, currency, quantity and source references in your calculation trace.

tools.name: write_handoff
tools.description: Submit the complete Markdown handoff for evidence/instruction checks.

tools.name: edit_handoff
tools.description: Repair a rejected draft with atomic, unique exact-text replacements.

tools.name: score_governance
tools.description: Apply existing row checks and the governance rubric to evidence-based rows. Topics leave behaviour_type, amount_funding_source and legal_capacity_link null; Extraction-Oriented is only a behaviour_flag direction. Flags require those three fields. Tool scoring does not certify the supplied evidence.

GovernanceItem.description: One row of T2D.3 (a governance topic) or T2D.4 (a behaviour flag).
